en.headline: Police arrest 59-year-old woman after dog allegedly thrown into sea in Sai Wan Ho
en.dek: Officers detained the woman on Saturday near Chai Wan on suspicion of animal cruelty following a Thursday incident in which a dog was thrown into the water and retrieved.
body: Police said a 59-year-old local woman was arrested on Saturday near the junction of Tai Hong Street and Lei King Road in Chai Wan on suspicion of cruelty to animals.

The arrest followed a report that a woman had thrown a dog into the sea from the waterfront near 29 Tai On Street in Sai Wan Ho at around 1pm on Thursday, then retrieved the animal and left. A passer-by alerted officers.

The woman was released on bail. Her two dogs, a male Jack Russell and a female Bichon, showed no visible injuries and were handed to the SPCA for examination and care. Police are investigating whether the dog thrown into the water was one of hers.

zh.headline: 西灣河疑掟狗落海 59歲女子涉虐畜被捕
zh.dek: 警方周六在柴灣拘捕一名59歲本地女子，涉上周四在太安街海濱將狗扔下海後撈起帶走，她已獲准保釋。
body: 警方表示，柴灣分區特遣隊人員經調查後，上周六下午在柴灣太康街及鯉景道交界對開，以涉嫌殘酷對待動物拘捕一名59歲本地女子。
案件源於上周四下午約一時，有途人報案指一名女子在西灣河太安街29號對開海濱將一隻狗扔下海，其後撈起帶走。
女子已獲准保釋候查。她所飼養的兩隻狗（雄性積羅素及雌性比高）沒有表面傷，已交由愛護動物協會檢查及照顧。警方正調查被扔下海的狗隻是否其中一隻。
